# Locomotion options

<!-- GENERATED by tests/ArcaneCore.World.Tests/Docs (ConfigReferenceRenderer.RenderByArea) from the options classes. Do not edit by hand.
     Regenerate: ARCANECORE_UPDATE_DOCS=1 dotnet test tests/ArcaneCore.World.Tests --filter Docs -->

17 options. Set them in the daemon's `.conf` file or `appsettings.json`. Full reference: [configuration.md](../configuration.md). All areas: [index](README.md).

Daemon says which server reads it. Reload says whether `.reload config` applies it: `live` is applied to the running server, `restart` keeps its value until the next start, `start` is read once when the daemon starts.

## `Locomotion`

| Option | Type | Default | Allowed | Daemon | Reload | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `EnvironmentalDamageMax` | `uint` | `610` | a whole number, 0 to 4294967295 | World | start | Highest lava damage per pulse (vmangos EnvironmentalDamage.Max, World.cpp:818, default 610, at least the minimum). |
| `EnvironmentalDamageMin` | `uint` | `605` | a whole number, 0 to 4294967295 | World | start | Lowest lava damage per pulse (vmangos EnvironmentalDamage.Min, World.cpp:817, default 605). |
| `GhostRunSpeedBattleground` | `float` | `1` | a number, '.' is the decimal point | World | start | The same inside a battleground (vmangos Death.Ghost.RunSpeed.BG, World.cpp:778, default 1). |
| `GhostRunSpeedWorld` | `float` | `1` | a number, '.' is the decimal point | World | start | Speed multiplier of a player whose death state is CORPSE, outside battlegrounds (vmangos Death.Ghost.RunSpeed.World, World.cpp:777, setConfigMinMax 0.1 to 10, default 1). Read literally as vmangos does (Unit.cpp:7044); at 1 it does nothing. |
| `MirrorTimerBreathMaxSec` | `uint` | `60` | a whole number, 0 to 4294967295 | World | start | Seconds of breath under water, times the water breathing multiplier (vmangos MirrorTimer.Breath.Max, World.cpp:815, default 60). |
| `MirrorTimerEnvironmentalMaxSec` | `uint` | `1` | a whole number, 0 to 4294967295 | World | start | Seconds in lava or slime before the first pulse (vmangos MirrorTimer.Environmental.Max, World.cpp:816, default 1). |
| `MirrorTimerFatigueMaxSec` | `uint` | `60` | a whole number, 0 to 4294967295 | World | start | Seconds of fatigue in deep water before the first pulse (vmangos MirrorTimer.Fatigue.Max, World.cpp:814, default 60). |
| `PendingAckResponseTimeMs` | `uint` | `4000` | a whole number, 0 to 4294967295 | World | start | How long the client has to acknowledge a server-ordered movement change before the server enforces it (vmangos Movement.PendingAckResponseTime, World.cpp:985, default 4000 ms; the wait is multiplied by 5 while the player is being teleported, Unit.cpp:6633). |
| `PlayerRunBackSpeedRate` | `float` | `1` | a number, '.' is the decimal point | World | live | Non-retail when not 1 (default 1): player run-back speed multiplier (the fork's Movement.RunSpeedRate on MOVE_RUN_BACK; 0.1 to 10; live). |
| `PlayerRunSpeedRate` | `float` | `1` | a number, '.' is the decimal point | World | live | Non-retail when not 1 (default 1): player run speed multiplier (the fork's Movement.RunSpeedRate, which also covers run back; 0.1 to 10; live). |
| `PlayerSpeedRate` | `float` | `1` | a number, '.' is the decimal point | World | live | Non-retail when not 1 (default 1, retail): multiplies every movement speed of every player (run, run back, swim, swim back, walk), on top of the per-type rates below. Not a vmangos key: the MaNGOS Zero fork's Movement.PlayerSpeedRate (feature/movement-enhancements, WorldConfig.cpp, percent 10 to 1000, applied in the player block of Unit::UpdateSpeed, UnitSpeed.cpp:162-168), here a multiplier clamped to 0.1 to 10. Applied where a player's speed is set (`UnitSpeed.SetRate`), so every speed change, force-speed packet and the server's own movement use the result. Live: `.reload config` and `.movement set` re-send the speeds of every online player. |
| `PlayerSwimBackSpeedRate` | `float` | `1` | a number, '.' is the decimal point | World | live | Non-retail when not 1 (default 1): player swim-back speed multiplier (the fork's Movement.SwimSpeedRate on MOVE_SWIM_BACK; 0.1 to 10; live). |
| `PlayerSwimSpeedRate` | `float` | `1` | a number, '.' is the decimal point | World | live | Non-retail when not 1 (default 1): player swim speed multiplier (the fork's Movement.SwimSpeedRate, which also covers swim back; 0.1 to 10; live). |
| `PlayerTurnRate` | `float` | `1` | a number, '.' is the decimal point | World | live | Non-retail when not 1 (default 1): player turn rate multiplier (0.1 to 10; live). Neither vmangos nor the fork has one; the base is vmangos baseMoveSpeed[MOVE_TURN_RATE] = 3.141594 rad/s (Unit.cpp:67-74). `PlayerSpeedRate` does not apply to it. A change reaches the client as SMSG_FORCE_TURN_RATE_CHANGE. |
| `PlayerWalkSpeedRate` | `float` | `1` | a number, '.' is the decimal point | World | live | Non-retail when not 1 (default 1): player walk speed multiplier (the fork's Movement.WalkSpeedRate; 0.1 to 10; live). |
| `RateDamageFall` | `float` | `1` | a number, '.' is the decimal point | World | start | Fall damage multiplier (vmangos Rate.Damage.Fall, World.cpp:533, default 1; setConfigPos: a negative value becomes 1). |
| `SlimeDamage` | `bool` | `false` | true \| false | World | start | Deliberate deviation, off by default: hurt in slime like in lava. vmangos (Player.cpp:1030-1040) and mangos-classic (Player.cpp:1305-1311, "FIXME ... Undercity") damage only in magma although both define DAMAGE_SLIME; whether retail 1.12 hurt in slime cannot be proven from the references. When on, a slime pulse deals the same 605-610 as lava. |
